verdict.rationale: Gemini offers task delegation via Gems (custom agents), scheduled recurring actions, Deep Research, and Connected Apps that let it take actions across other apps (Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Flights) with user permission, all built into the product. This covers task delegation to a built-in assistant well beyond simple Q&A. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of agentic task execution reliability and no benchmark evidence specifically testing delegated multi-step task completion.
